reports.title: Ngaahi Lipooti
reports.description: Ngaahi lipooti palani ʻo makatuʻunga ʻi he hisitōlia ʻo e fakatahá kuo lekooti.
reports.notesDescription: Toe vakaiʻi ʻa e ngaahi fakamatala fakauōtí ʻoku ʻasi ki hoʻo ʻakauní.

reports.speakerReportDescription: Lekooti ‘a e ngaahi malanga, ngaahi lau, mo e ngaahi ‘aho malanga fakamuimuitaha.
reports.topicReportDescription: Ngaahi kaveinga ‘oku ‘omai ‘e he kau leá mo e ‘aho ‘o e fakatahá.

reports.prayerReportDescription: Lekooti ʻa e ngaahi ngāue ʻo e lotú mo e ngaahi ʻaho fakaʻosí.
reports.completenessReportDescription: Mole ngaahi fakaikiiki 'oku fiema'u ke toe vakai'i kimu'a pea toki pulusi.
